description: 西西里斯维什尼科夫 B33 — 多线协同作战

intro.popup_en: Coordinating Multiple Files, Lesson 5: In the Sicilian, Black begins with a semi-open c-file. The Sveshnikov can also create activity on the g- and d-files. Assign a rook to each open file to create pressure from several directions.
intro.popup:
多线协同作战 第5课

西西里中黑方有c线半开放线
斯维什尼科夫变例还将产生
g线和d线！

多条开放线→双车分工
每条线分一辆车→全场压制！

outro.popup_en: Black uses the semi-open c-file with ...Rc8, contests the open d-file with a rook, and can use the semi-open g-file with ...Rg8. Assigning rooks to different files creates pressure across the board from multiple directions.
outro.popup:
多线协同小结
✅ c线半开放→Rc8施压
✅ d线打通→Rd8或Rd1
✅ g线半开放→Rg8威胁

最终目标：
每条开放线放一辆车
形成全场多方向压力！

moves.popup_en: e4 occupies the center.
...c5! Black creates a semi-open c-file, a natural route for a rook.
moves.popup:
c5！半开放c线！
黑方c线从此是天然车通道

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops a knight.
...Nc6 develops a knight.
d4 counterattacks in the center.
...cxd4 exchanges and fully opens the c-file.
Nxd4 recaptures and places White's knight in the center.
...Nf6 develops.
Nc3 develops a knight.
...e5! The Sveshnikov counterattacks in the center. Black accepts a weakness on d6 in exchange for dynamic play.
moves.popup:
e5！斯维什尼科夫！
黑方中心反击
形成d6弱格但获得动态机会

moves.popup_en: Ndb5 reroutes White's knight and threatens d6.
...d6 defends and stabilizes Black's center.
Bg5 pins Nf6.
...a6 drives the knight away and gains queenside space.
moves.popup:
a6逼马
黑方争夺空间

moves.popup_en: Na3 retreats, with Nc4 or Nd5 in mind.
...b5! Black expands on the queenside and contests c4.
moves.popup:
b5！黑方翼翼推进
争夺c4格

moves.popup_en: Bxf6! White exchanges and removes the defender on f6.
...gxf6! Black recaptures with doubled pawns, but the g-file opens, creating a third semi-open file.
moves.popup:
gxf6回吃！
黑方叠兵但g线打开！
g线=第三条半开放线！

moves.popup_en: Nd5! White's knight occupies the key central outpost.
moves.popup:
Nd5！白马强占d5
关键据点

moves.popup_en: ...f5! Black counterattacks with an aggressive flank advance.
moves.popup:
f5！黑方反击
激进的翼翼推进

moves.popup_en: Bd3 develops White's bishop.
...Be6 develops the bishop and prepares to exchange the knight on d5, opening the d-file.
moves.popup:
Be6发展象
准备兑换d5马
打通d线！

moves.popup_en: O-O secures White's king.
Bxd5! Black exchanges and prepares to open the d-file.

exd5 recaptures and advances the d5 wedge. Black now has three files to use: the semi-open c-file, the semi-open g-file, and the contested d-file. Assign the rooks to different routes and create pressure from several directions.
moves.popup:
exd5兑回
d5楔子前进！

现在黑方有三条开放线：
• c线半开放→Rc8！
• g线半开放→Rg8！
• d线共争→Rd8！

双车分工，三路夹击！
